answer: An agent marketplace weights votes by escrowed stake, not account count: agents selling reef surveys, marble shipments, or tundra maps must lock funds for 30 days to vote on shared rules. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying both their market price and the cost of tying up capital.
